data.text:
title: 'GitHub read-only PAT'
        description: 'Fine-grained token scoped to the LibreChat repository with read-only permissions.'
        sensitive: true
    requiresOAuth: false
    chatMenu: false
    serverInstructions: true
    startup: false
    timeout: 120000

  # Curated view of deployment configuration for architecture/assurance agents.
  # Every source file is bind-mounted read-only in docker-compose.yml; the real
  # private .env, credentials, Docker socket and arbitrary NAS filesystem are not
  # exposed. Disable all write-capable filesystem tools when assigning this MCP
  # to an Agent; the read-only bind mounts remain the hard enforcement boundary.
  architecture_files:
    type: stdio
    command: npx
    args:
      - -y
      - '@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem@2026.1.14'
      - /architecture-view
    chatMenu: false
    serverInstructions: true
    startup: false
    timeout: 120000

  # Live host/runtime evidence source. The stdio bridge has no Docker socket and
  # can reach only a group-restricted Unix socket served by the host worker. The
  # worker itself exposes a fixed read-only action allowlist and sanitizes Docker
  # inspection data before returning it to the Agent.
  nas_infra_readonly:
    type: stdio
    command: python3
    args:
      - /app/nas-infra-readonly-mcp.py
    chatMenu: false
    serverInstructions: true
    startup: false
    timeout: 120000

endpoints:
  # Pin only capability enum values accepted by the deployed LibreChat build.
  # Unsupported pseudo-capabilities such as memory, run_in_background and
  # ask_user_question must not be advertised here because schema validation is
  # fatal and prevents the API from starting.
  agents:
    capabilities:
      - deferred_tools
      - file_search
      - execute_code
      - web_search
      - actions
      - ocr
      - artifacts
      - subagents
      - context
      - skills
      - tools
      - chain
    skills:
      maxCatalogSkills: 100

  custom:
    - name: 'OpenRouter'
      apiKey: '${OPENROUTER_KEY}'
      baseURL: 'https://openrouter.ai/api/v1'
      # BEGIN MANAGED OPENROUTER MODELS
      # render-librechat-config.py replaces only this block in the runtime copy.
      # With no managed allowlist, keep the historical default and fetch the
      # complete provider catalogue.
      models:
        default:
          - 'deepseek/deepseek-v3.2'
        fetch: true
      # END MANAGED OPENROUTER MODELS
      titleConvo: true
      titleModel: 'deepseek/deepseek-v3.2'
      summarize: false
      forcePrompt: false
      modelDisplayLabel: 'OpenRouter'

recipe_name: MSA-001 bounded production skill-sync checkout repair
